text:
Elena (Mktg): Hey design — planning a tight bundle for next week's launch/demo. Need a small deliverable list so we can coordinate handoffs: 1) benchmark comparison grid for landing page + social card, 2) webinar hero + 1-slide TL;DR graphic, 3) email header variations (light/dark), 4) inbound lead routing diagram (simple flow), and 5) brand-compliance checklist for localized creatives. ETA: 48 hours if possible. :pray:

Ravi (Design): Thanks — can do but need clarifs. For the benchmark grid, do you want full verticals (latency, cost, quality) or just 3 highlights? Also what sizes for social card?

Elena (Mktg): Go with 3 highlights: latency (p50), cost per 1k tokens, and qualitative note (short). Social: two sizes — 1200x628 (FB/LinkedIn) and 1080x1080 (IG). Include brand-safe color variants.

Sam (Growth): Also add a microcopy variant for the social card CTA: "See the numbers" vs "Compare latency & cost" — we should A/B test. Keep CTA area isolated in mockups.

Ravi (Design): Got it. For webinar hero — do you want photo or illustration? We have an illustration style that matches the bench tiles and a hero photo option. Photo might feel more enterprise.

Nina (PMM): Illustration preferred for consistency with benchmark visuals. Use the new palette (v2) and avoid saturated gradients per legal. Add a note: include speaker headshots as circular overlays at 120px.

Ravi (Design): Note taken. I'll produce: - benchmark grid PNG + source Figma page - social card variants (two sizes, two CTA copies) - webinar hero (1920x1080) + 1-slide TL;DR (1024x576) - email header 600x200 (light/dark) - routing diagram SVG (editable) - brand-compliance checklist (PDF)

DesignOps Bot: Reminder: upload final assets to /shared/launch-assets/4876543210/ and tag with "bench-launch-4876".

Elena (Mktg): Perfect — key ask: make the benchmark grid easily skimmable on mobile. Use dot sparklines for latency trends and a tiny legend. Keep copy to one short sentence per model.

Ravi (Design): Will keep copy under 12 words/model. Quick spec inside Figma:

```
Benchmark grid: 3 columns (Latency p50, Cost/1k tokens, Quality note)
Row height: 48px on desktop, 36px mobile
Dot sparklines: 64x12
Font stack: Inter 600 for model, Inter 400 for copy
Color tokens: --brand-ink, --muted-600, --accent-500
```

Sam (Growth): For the inbound routing diagram, can you include annotations for: webhook -> Redwood hosted API -> Dedicated fallback -> Email to ops? Want it clear where canary traffic goes.

Ravi (Design): Yes — I'll add arrows and a small table showing percentages for canary (5/20/50).

Nina (PMM): Legal note: avoid using competitor logos in the grid. Use generic labels like "Open model A". Also include alt-text for all images.

Elena (Mktg): Thanks team. If you can upload first drafts in 24 hours to Figma and tag me + @Sam, we'll do a quick round before finalizing. :sparkles:

Ravi (Design): ETA 24h for drafts, 48h for final assets. Starting now. :thumbsup:
